name: verbose mode does not reopen a terminal the user never opened
why: The floor is code, not a mode. Verbose narrates the terminal the user is watching; a spawned session has no terminal to watch, so turning the dial up must not turn the fleet into a radio. Idle is silent here too: a headless gate denies itself on silence, so nagging that it is waiting would advertise a wait the machinery already resolves.
